propositions: Extract identity transition logic (bind, confirm, unbind, numeric-ID re-key, stale reverse cleanup) from BindingStore into a cohesive BindingLifecycle slice while preserving all existing behavior and public facade signatures.
Every bind/confirm/unbind transition must maintain at most one forward entry and one matching reverse entry per local ID, with targeted single-key pops rather than sweep or ambiguity detection.
The bind_confirm operation must remain last-writer-wins on the forward entry, popping exactly one old reverse key when it differs, with no sweep, ambiguity detection, or abort.
Stale reverse entries may be removed only in four permitted cases: bind_confirm rebind, unbind with orphan sweep, numeric-ID re-key, and _retire, never in other scenarios.

The note_absent_or_rekey seam coordinates facade-level decisions (guard, no-client/no-ID fallthrough, by-ID lookup) while delegating only the re-key mutation step to BindingLifecycle.rekey, preserving the True/False return contract and all caller-visible outcomes.

Immutable numeric-ID re-key must move issues instead of retiring them: set new jira_key, reset absent_404_count, stamp updated_at, pop old reverse key, insert new one, save, and emit binding-rekeyed event.
